title: Trot Mobility
summary: A smart, eco-friendly horse-drawn carriage for Egypt's North Coast resorts. The frame was generated in Grasshopper and refined with FEA to be light and strong.
summary_ar: عربة حنطور ذكية وصديقة للبيئة لمنتجعات الساحل الشمالي في مصر. صُمم هيكلها في Grasshopper ثم حُسّن بتحليل العناصر المحدودة ليكون خفيفًا ومتينًا.

sections.heading: The brief
sections.body:
North Coast resorts in Egypt are large and spread out, so getting around them usually means a car. The brief was a short-distance transport system that is eco-friendly and human-centred, serves both tourists and resort staff, and cuts the need for private cars.

The answer combines a physical product with a supporting system, inspired by the traditional horse carriage.

sections.heading: The ride
sections.body:
- The seats flip, so riders can face the view.
- A controller talks to an autonomous AI system to make the ride more fun.
- A collet lets the horse be released quickly, so horses can be swapped between stops for breaks.

sections.heading: A frame grown by parameters
sections.body: I modelled the frame with parametric and generative design in Grasshopper, then used FEA results to optimise the geometry for the lowest weight and the most strength.

sections.heading: Prototype
sections.body:
I also built a physical prototype. Photos will be added here soon.

Supervised by Dr. Ahmed Romouzy, Eng. Dina Nabil and Eng. Rana Yehia.
